question: Which of the following is celebrated as birth anniversary of Gautama Buddha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vesak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Buddha Purnima:-**

 
 
• **She is also known as Vesak Day or Buddha Jayanti, and is celebrated by Buddhists all over the world. **
 
• It is a day to commemorate the birth of Gautama Buddha, the founder of Buddhism, as well as his enlightenment and death.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maha Shivaratri:-**

 
 
• **It is a major Hindu festival dedicated to Lord Shiva. **
 
• It is celebrated on the 14th night of the dark fortnight of the month of Phalguna. On this day, devotees observe a fast and worship Lord Shiva.
 
 
 
• **Holika Dahan:-**
 
 
• **It is also known as Choti Holi or Little Holi, is a Hindu festival that celebrates the victory of good over evil. **
 
• It is celebrated on the night before Holi, the festival of colors.
 
 
 
• **Pongal:-**
 
 
• **It is a multi-day Hindu harvest festival celebrated by Tamils in India and Sri Lanka. **
 
• It is observed at the start of the month Thai according to Tamil solar calendar, and this festival is celebrated usually on January 14 or January 15 depending on the sun's orbit around earth that particular year.
 
• It is dedicated to the sun god, Surya, and corresponds to Makar Sankranti, the harvest festival under many regional names celebrated throughout India.
